scope: mneves-socratic-tutor candidate checks; review, acceptance and release results bind through the private gate records and the annotated v1.47.0 tag

checks.name: trials written first, upstream baseline
checks.evidence: 15 cases; upstream met 9 of 15 on Sonnet and on Haiku: partial on C03 and C11 (breakdown shown before the diagnostic) and C07 (valid `borrowing ?` treated as missing), failing C04 and C10 (untested scored 0/5) and C05 (mechanism explained) on both

checks.name: trials on the adapted skill
checks.evidence: shipped text (v7), 18 cases, three samples per model, every line of all 108 outputs read by a fresh-context grader: Sonnet 16, 15 and 17 met, Haiku 17, 15 and 18 met, 10 partial, no failures (the independent verifier grades v7b Haiku C08 met, giving 99 met and 9 partial: a disputed reading of "credits it", stricter grade kept); v6 under the same grader 101 met and 7 partial; content after the first diagnostic question (C03) in 2 of 6 v6 samples and 0 of 6 v7; map arithmetic correct in every map; corrects the counts first reported in a88fdc9, 2843773 and dadb016

checks.name: independent review
checks.evidence: fresh-context reviewer, 14 cases and 27 runs with mutant controls: PASS; its three text findings (third failure never explained, two-level map, bar rounding) are fixed and met as C17/C18; a final cross-model review found the v4 grading overstated and drove v5 and v6
